name: patient_has_finding_of_short_stature_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has short stature.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of short stature.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of short stature.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of short stature.

name: patient_has_finding_of_short_stature_now@@due_to_growth_hormone_deficiency
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current short stature is due to growth hormone deficiency.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current short stature is due to growth hormone deficiency.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current short stature is not due to growth hormone deficiency.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current short stature is due to growth hormone deficiency.

name: patient_body_height_value_recorded_inthepast6months_withunit_cm
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's height (in centimeters) as officially recorded at least 6 months prior to screening.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such official height record exists or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value (in centimeters) if an official height record exists for the patient from at least 6 months prior to screening.

name: patient_body_height_value_recorded_inthepast6months_withunit_cm@@is_official_record
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the height record is an official record.
when_true: Set to true if the height record is an official record.
when_false: Set to false if the height record is not an official record.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the height record is official.

name: patient_has_finding_of_short_stature_now@@due_to_idiopathic_short_stature
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current short stature is due to idiopathic short stature.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current short stature is due to idiopathic short stature.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current short stature is not due to idiopathic short stature.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current short stature is due to idiopathic short stature.

name: patient_has_undergone_measuring_height_of_patient_inthepast6months
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone a height measurement procedure at least 6 months prior to inclusion.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has an official record of a height measurement procedure performed at least 6 months prior to inclusion.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have an official record of a height measurement procedure performed at least 6 months prior to inclusion.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has an official height measurement procedure from at least 6 months prior to inclusion.

name: patient_has_finding_of_short_stature_by_small_for_gestational_age_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has short stature by the criterion of being small for gestational age.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has short stature and this is determined by the patient being small for gestational age.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have short stature by the criterion of being small for gestational age.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has short stature by the criterion of being small for gestational age.

name: patient_body_height_measure_value_recorded_inthehistory_withunit_cm
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's height (in centimeters) as recorded at any time in the patient's history.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value (in centimeters) if an official height measurement is recorded at any time in the patient's history.

name: patient_body_height_measure_value_recorded_inthehistory_withunit_cm@@official_record
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the height measurement is from an official record.
when_true: Set to true if the height measurement is from an official record.
when_false: Set to false if the height measurement is not from an official record.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the height measurement is from an official record.

name: patient_body_height_measure_value_recorded_inthehistory_withunit_cm@@temporalcontext_at_least_6_months_prior_to_screening
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the height measurement was recorded at least six months prior to the screening date.
when_true: Set to true if the height measurement was recorded at least six months prior to the screening date.
when_false: Set to false if the height measurement was recorded less than six months prior to the screening date.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the height measurement was recorded at least six months prior to screening.

name: patient_has_official_height_record_at_least_6_months_prior_to_screening
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has an official height record dated at least six months prior to screening.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has an official height record dated at least six months prior to screening.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have such a record.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the patient has such a record.

name: patient_has_finding_of_epiphyseal_closure_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has epiphyseal closure.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of epiphyseal closure.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of epiphyseal closure.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of epiphyseal closure.
